name: Listagrow AI Product Listing and Catalog Enrichment
author: Listagrow AI

sections.description:
Listagrow for WooCommerce is the official companion plugin linking your WooCommerce store to the Listagrow Platform — an AI-powered ecommerce product listing, catalog enrichment, and product photography service.

This plugin provides the local WordPress and WooCommerce integration bridge, enabling merchants to connect their catalog and launch product generation and enrichment directly from the WooCommerce admin.

What This Plugin Does (WordPress Side)

  • Seamless 1-Click Store Connection: Securely links your WooCommerce store with your Listagrow workspace.
  • REST API & System Diagnostics: Automatically verifies WooCommerce version compatibility, Pretty Permalinks configuration and SSL/HTTPS status.
  • Product Edit Screen Integration: Adds a “Listagrow AI Content Studio” meta box directly to the WooCommerce product edit page.
  • Product Catalog Row Actions: Adds a direct “Enrich in Listagrow” row action link in the WooCommerce Products table.

What the Listagrow Platform Does (Cloud Side)

AI generation and image processing are handled by Listagrow’s dedicated cloud infrastructure at app.listagrow.com:

  • Bulk AI Product Generation & Enrichment: Generates SEO-optimized product titles, persuasive long and short descriptions, bullet points, tags, and category attributes from supplier data, images, or sparse catalog entries.
  • AI Image Studio: Automatically isolates product subjects, removes cluttered backgrounds, generates studio lighting, and standardizes visual brand presentation.
  • WooCommerce Attribute & Category Mapping: Extracts structured attributes (colors, sizes, materials) and maps categories directly for WooCommerce.
  • Human-in-the-Loop Review Gate: Every AI proposal sits in a dedicated review queue. Merchants have full control to approve, modify, or reject updates before anything publishes to WooCommerce.
  • Two-Way Catalog Sync: Pulls active WooCommerce products for processing and publishes approved content back via the official WooCommerce REST API.

External Service Disclosure

This plugin acts as a companion connector for the external cloud platform Listagrow. To use the plugin to enrich your catalog, you must connect your store with a Listagrow account.

  • Provider: Listagrow (https://listagrow.com)
  • Application URL: https://app.listagrow.com
  • Terms of Service: https://listagrow.com/terms-of-service
  • Privacy Policy: https://listagrow.com/privacy-policy

Data Transmitted: When you choose to connect your store and initiate catalog synchronization or product enrichment, your WooCommerce product catalog information (titles, descriptions, attributes, categories, SKUs, and public image URLs) is securely transmitted to Listagrow servers over encrypted HTTPS.

Customer Privacy: Customer records, orders, buyer personal data, and payment information are never accessed, requested, or transmitted.
sections.installation:
1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for Listagrow for WooCommerce.
  4. Click Install Now, then click Activate.
  5. Go to WooCommerce > Listagrow AI in the left admin menu.
  6. Verify your system diagnostics (Pretty Permalinks and SSL) and click Connect with Listagrow.
  7. Approve the connection to link your WooCommerce store with your Listagrow workspace.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin edit my WooCommerce products automatically?

No. Listagrow enforces a strict review gate. All AI-generated content and enhanced images remain in your Listagrow workspace for your review and approval. Updates are only pushed back to WooCommerce when you explicitly approve and publish them.

Do I need a Listagrow account?

Yes. Connecting your store requires a Listagrow account. You can create an account for free with starter credits included.

Why does the plugin require Pretty Permalinks?

The WooCommerce REST API and native WooCommerce OAuth authorization require Pretty Permalinks (e.g., /%postname%/) to route API requests. Plain permalinks (/?p=123) disable REST routing in WordPress.

Does this plugin access customer or order data?

No. Listagrow only accesses product catalog information (titles, descriptions, attributes, images, categories, and inventory SKU) necessary for content enrichment and image processing.
